name: code-intel
description: LSP-backed semantic symbol navigation and call-graph MCP server: locate symbols, trace incoming callers (including non-call references), outgoing callees, and interface implementations across Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Rust, C/C++, and Swift.
suggestedPrompts: Find all callers and non-call references of a function before changing its signature
Trace the 2-hop upstream call chain of a symbol to assess refactoring impact
List all concrete implementations of an interface, protocol, or base method
